body:
I smoke weed every day 24/7 and lately I haven't even been getting high any more, due to tolerance. I also have lots of hangups about smoking weed since it is the only illegal thing I do. I am a good person, but I could go to jail any time, and I don't deserve it! It is a constant source of worry.
Tonight I was over at my friend D's house and his friend had some of this Mojo Botanical Incense that he'd bought at some gas station for like 30 bucks for 3 grams. I was skeptical about anything legal, but decided to smoke it. We shared a joint of this shit among 4 people, and for the first time in months and months, I got REALLY fucking high. It was like smoking weed, after I haven't smoked weed for a long time. It felt EXACTLY like weed. Down to the minor paranoia. It felt GREAT. I couldn't believe it. And the shit is LEGAL! It's a bit more expensive than the swag I smoke, but it got me twice as high since it was a different chemical and I had no tolerance to it. I mean, this shit annihilated me, I had to lay down!
I might just switch to legal smokes from now on. That way I won't have to worry ANYMORE, I can truly be a free citizen now. Of course, if I get a tolerance to the Mojo, I will just have to switch back to weed for a while. Either way, I get to be high all day every day. Yay. And P.S. I promise I am not some salesperson working for Mojo. This shit is real, and everyone should know about it so we won't have to be USED as free work by the prison system.
LET'S LEGALIZE IT!!!!!!! peace.
